messages:
sophia: Heads up — nightly full integration run against Hosted API went red in fanout mode. Failures concentrated on tool-call + streaming scenarios, looks timing-related. attaching initial notes.
ci-bot: nightly-integrations failed: 8/432 tests red — see https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/8870 (summary).
ben: @sophia can you paste the exact failing test names or a tiny repro?
sophia: failing tests: tests/integration/test_tool_streaming.py::test_tool_stream_multi_shard and tests/integration/test_auth_retries.py::test_jwks_race. repro seems to hit only when fanout>1.
lee: i noticed something similar yesterday in staging — proxy returns 502 while tool process is still establishing streaming handshake.
maya: could be routing to a cold region or an intermediate proxy timing out. can we narrow to shard ids?
sophia: observed failures on shards: 9, 21, 33 (sampled from fanout run). attaching a minimal curl below that reproduces the 502.

sophia: ```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $HOSTED_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2","input":"ping","tools":[{"name":"calc","call":true}],"stream":true}' \\
  https://hosted.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

sophia: response snippet:```
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
{"error":"upstream timeout during toolcall streaming handshake"}
```

ben: quick grep of the proxy logs for rq_0a1b2c3d shows: `TOOLCALL: init seq 0 -> 0x7f...`, then `proxy: upstream timed out after 3.01s`, then a 502 relay.
lee: i can pull shard sampler logs and the runner labels. request id?
sophia: rq id is rq_0a1b2c3d (included in curl response headers).
maya: i'm going to try a local fanout=4 run and re-run only the failing shards to get deterministic traces. queuing targeted rerun for shard 9 first.
ben: also checking the jwks cache code path for the auth_retries test — there was a short TTL window where refresh+serve race could surface when fanout parallelizes many connections.
lee: suggestion: while we triage, add an CI-level flaky mitigation to auto-rerun failed shards (1 retry) so PRs don't get blocked. low risk and buys us time.
sophia: sounds reasonable. who can queue the reruns now?
maya: queued reruns: https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/8891 (shard9), https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/8892 (shard21). runner assigned: ci-agent-7.
ci-bot: rerun started (8891) — triggered by maya.
ben: i'm going to open a small PR to add a 3s backoff/retry in the proxy for toolcall streaming handshakes, gated by experiment flag `exp.toolcall_stream_retry`. will link when ready.
lee: i'll fetch full tracer spans after rerun finishes and correlate with kernel/log timestamps.
sophia: perfect. if reruns reproduce, please include raw proxy traces and the tool process stdout/stderr.
maya: rerun (8891) finished: shard9 passed on retry, logs show the initial tool handshake took ~2.9s then succeeded. attaching trace snippet in the rerun artifact.
ben: good signal — timing window around ~3s. i'll fast-follow with PR and keep flag off by default.
sophia: thanks team. i'll keep monitoring the rest of the shards, and will open an incident note if more than 5% fail on subsequent runs.
lee: ping me if you want me to bisect runner versions — i can run the sampler across agent-6/7 to rule out agent differences.
sophia: will do. updating the failing test tickets with these notes. TY :heart:
